items.excerpt: Congratulations to the UCPEA Unionists of the Year, Daniel Lis and Harrison Goodale, Advocacy Awardee, Christianne Smith and Campus Connection Awardee, Kimberly Miller. We hope their stories inspire others.

items.title: UCPEA Produce and Craft Swap
items.excerpt: Starting July 8, the UCPEA Produce Swap returns, giving members a chance to share or trade extra garden produce. Membership Services is also launching a new Craft Swap, an eco-friendly event where sewers, knitters, painters, DIYers, scrapbookers, jewelry makers, and other crafters can exchange supplies and creative materials.
items.label: Community

items.title: Join the UCPEA Book Club!
items.excerpt: The UCPEA Book Club is launching this July! The book club will meet virtually on the third Wednesday of each month to discuss books and connect with colleagues. Whether an avid reader or simply looking for an enjoyable conversation with fellow members, we welcome you to join!

items.title: All Eyes on the Delaney Hall Hunger Strike
items.excerpt: A humanitarian crisis is unfolding at Delaney Hall, the East Coast’s largest ICE detention center, where a massive hunger and labor strike has ignited violent clashes between law enforcement and protesters outside, alongside reports of brutal retaliation against detainees inside.
items.label: Union Wire

items.title: ICE out of Connecticut: Hands Off CT
items.excerpt: On Wednesday June 3rd at 4pm join community members and neighbors around the state as we declare that we want ICE out of Connecticut. This action is part of Hands Off CT, a network united around protecting communities from the violence of the immigration enforcement system.
items.label: Union Wire

items.title: Contract Corner: Understanding Article 32
items.excerpt: The Union Wire is bringing back the “Contract Corner” column. The goal is to explain contractual benefits without all the legalese. We will be starting with some of the contract articles with the most substantive changes in the new iteration of the Collective Bargaining Agreement. What better way to start than to review the key points of Article 32, the Salary Article.
items.label: Article
